signals.text: Emery left searching for answers after another Villa loss. Aston Villa have lost three of their opening four Premier League games to leave boss Unai Emery struggling for answers.
Solanke struggles, but Branthwaite solid - Spurs v Everton player ratings. How Spurs and Everton's players rated following their Premier League match, which ended in a goalless draw.

'A clear red card' - Emery berates VAR as Villa lose late to Forest. Aston Villa manager Unai Emery was left frustrated with the match officials after they chose to not send off Nottingham Forest's James McAtee, following a challenge on Ian Maatsen which left the defender injured and meant Villa had to play the closing stages of the match with 10 men, with Forest taking advantage, scoring late to win 2-1 at Villa Park.
Richarlison could still leave Spurs - Saturday's gossip. Interest in Richarlison, Philippe Coutinho agrees Santos deal and Manchester United monitoring Adrien Truffert.
